note: The root key records the place name’s consonants. Genesis 11:9 links בָּבֶל by sound with בָּלַל, “he confused.”
summary: Babel is a city in the land of Shinar. Genesis 10:10 lists it first among the cities of Nimrod’s early kingdom.

senses.definition: The city of Babylon in the land of Shinar, called Babel in Genesis.

evidence.note: Babel heads the list with Erech, Akkad, and Calneh in the land of Shinar.
The narrator gives בָּבֶל as the name of the city whose builders Yahweh scattered.
